background: Citigroup is the holding company of the most international of the large US banks, with services, markets, banking, wealth and US personal banking as its main lines, and a multi-year restructuring behind it.
synthesis: Rated A- on average across all three, the weakest of them at BBB+, one on a positive outlook; the last move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 2 Dec 2015, and as a holding company it rates below its operating bank. Capital is on the weak side of US banks, with CET1 of 12.8% and leverage of 5.2% both below the peer median. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.7 points, leverage 0.4 points and Tier 1 leverage 0.5 points, a drift lower worth watching. LCR of 113% sits at the median and has held flat.
